title: Oracle Customer to Meter (C2M) Installation & Multi-Environment Build (Dev/Test/Prod)
author_notes: Effort tier: T5 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Stand up Oracle Customer to Meter — correctly, in every environment
problem: Installing Oracle Utilities Customer to Meter (C2M) across Development, Test, and Production is where utility programs stall — certified stacks, OUAF setup, WebLogic domains, and database schemas all have to line up. This solution is the end-to-end C2M installation and multi-environment build: certified prerequisites, OUAF/product install, WebLogic domain creation, database initial setup, and environment configuration — done consistently across Dev/Test/Prod, pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M/OUAF architecture (product home, WebLogic domain, database schema), the certified stack, and the standard build model across environments.
Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensed C2M + WebLogic 14c entitlement, certified OS/JDK/DB, environment access, MOS access).

Installation Guide — exact ordered steps: certified prereqs, OUAF/product install, WebLogic domain creation, database initial setup, environment configuration (`configureEnv`/`initialSetup`), and post-install validation, per environment.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (product up, domain healthy, schema valid) plus Best Practices for repeatable multi-environment builds.
short: The end-to-end Oracle C2M installation and multi-environment build — certified prereqs, OUAF install, WebLogic domain, database setup, config — consistent across Dev/Test/Prod, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
